chunks: In which he will neither die nor live.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that the inhabitants of Hell neither die nor live?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the unique state of *al-Ba's* (the worst torment) where the disbelievers are denied the mercy of death to end their suffering and the vitality of life to find relief, creating a state of perpetual stagnation. This condition is often contrasted with the temporary punishment of the *Muwahhidun* (monotheists) who may eventually exit Hell, emphasizing the finality of the disbelievers' fate as described in the *Tafsir al-Ayyashi* and *Al-Mizan*. The phrase underscores the completeness of their deprivation, serving as a theological anchor for the concept of eternal abode in the Hereafter.
